title: Bind historical x1 assertions to immutable Git blobs
failure_signature: A historical x1 assertion reads an append-only live lifecycle ledger after x2 evidence is added.
trigger_preconditions: The x1 commit is known and ancestral.
The asserted x1 artifact is immutable in that commit.
The live artifact is intentionally append-only.
candidate_workaround: Read only the historical assertion target from the exact x1 Git blob while keeping current lifecycle assertions live.
recurrence_guard: Declare whether each lifecycle assertion is historical or live before selecting its data source.
rollback: Restore the live read, retain the failing selection, and stop if the x1 commit or blob path is not exact.
scope_boundary: Historical test binding only; no evidence, authority, or independent-reproduction promotion.
